matched_rules.because: Signals show simultaneous failure of two cooling systems (redundant) and extraordinarily high outside temperatures, matching the rule's when conditions.

next_actions.action: Immediately assess whether the data center can maintain a safe operating temperature, and if not, plan to power down servers to prevent an even longer outage or damage to machines.

escalate.reason: Simultaneous failure of redundant cooling systems and rising temperatures (R-005 trigger).

not_covered: No rule addresses the specific scenario of two cooling systems failing while outside temperatures are extraordinarily high without additional signals such as utility voltage swells, control-system failover, or standby chiller water circuit sharing.
No rule covers the initial alert and investigation phase before cooling failure is confirmed or thermal buffer status is known.

per_finding.note: R-005 names simultaneous failure of redundant cooling systems plus extraordinarily high outside temperatures as the root cause.
Triage only mentions powering down servers, not terminating 42% of PVMs to reduce thermal load and enable zonal failover.
R-005's next action directs powering down servers to prevent a longer outage or machine damage.
No rule or action addresses developing advanced methods to progressively decrease thermal load within a data center.
Triage does not call for an audit of cooling system equipment and standards across data centers.
Triage gives no indication of the 4 hour 8 minute impact duration.
